channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Ole Miss Investigates Racist Gestures by Students
item.description: The University of Mississippi (Ole Miss) is investigating white students who were filmed making racist gestures. The incident was captured on video and has prompted an inquiry by the university. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Hungary PM's Brother Detained in People-Smuggling Probe
item.description: Gyorgy Orban, the brother of Hungary's former Prime Minister Viktor Orban, has been detained in connection with a people-smuggling investigation. Hungarian police reportedly took him into custody. The detention was confirmed by Hungary's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Fan brawl erupts outside Levi's Stadium during 49ers-Raiders game
item.description: Multiple arrests and ejections occurred following a brawl between fans of the 49ers and Raiders outside Levi's Stadium. The fight took place in the parking lot as the rivalry between the teams escalated. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Teen Driver Charged in Fatal Crash
item.description: A 15-year-old driver has been charged in connection with a fatal crash that occurred in the Oneida Nation of the Thames. The incident involved a collision that resulted in the death of a teen. Separately, a 17-year-old driver was killed in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Inquiry Finds Decades of Abuse at Edinburgh Academy
item.description: An inquiry has found that pupils at Edinburgh Academy suffered "dreadful abuse" over several decades. The findings detail abuse experienced by children at the UK private school. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Toronto Police Identify Man Found Dead Over 30 Years Ago
item.description: Toronto police have identified the remains of a man, known only as 'Derek,' who died over 30 years ago. The identification was made possible through the use of DNA technology and genetic genealogy. The man was found dead in 1992. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: House report criticizes handling of Epstein case, urges reinterviews
item.description: A report by the Republican-led House Oversight Committee has criticized what it calls systemic failures in the handling of the Jeffrey Epstein case, particularly concerning the release of records by the Trump administration. The committee… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Florida court allows Trump's defamation suit against BBC to proceed
item.description: A Florida court has ruled that Donald Trump's defamation lawsuit against the BBC can move forward. The lawsuit, seeking $10 billion in damages, alleges the British broadcaster defamed him. The judge's decision permits the case to continue. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Australia to mandate AI safeguards after OpenAI hack
item.description: Australia is set to introduce mandatory safeguards for artificial intelligence following an OpenAI hack. The government plans to amend criminal laws to prevent companies from claiming ignorance regarding AI misuse. While OpenAI will not… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Charges Three Men with Plotting Terror Attacks
item.description: Three men have been charged in the United States with plotting multiple terrorist attacks, including a planned assault on a UK airbase. One of the accused is an Iran-backed militant who allegedly helped plot the attack on the UK's Fairford… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: David Walliams Accused of Sexual Misconduct and Grooming
item.description: British children's author and television personality David Walliams has been accused of sexual misconduct and grooming. Reports state the allegations involve girls as young as 15. The accusations have emerged in press reviews and coverage… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand Sentenced for Rape and Sexual Assault; New Allegations Emerge
item.description: Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and 6 months in prison for rape and sexual assault. A judge described him as a "sexual predator" during sentencing. The sentencing occurred in a "squalid and unsafe" London jail. In the wake of… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Cash App Founder's Killer Sentenced to 16 Years to Life
item.description: Bob Lee, the founder of Cash App, was killed by tech consultant Nima Moghaddam. Moghaddam has been sentenced to 16 years to life in prison for the killing. The sentencing occurred in relation to the death of Lee. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Baby Found Alive After Being Buried for 24 Hours
item.description: An 11-month-old baby was found alive after being buried for approximately 24 hours in South Carolina. The infant was discovered inside a dog crate. The rescue involved nearly 100 law enforcement officers and emergency personnel. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Brazil Fines Meta $1.3 Million for Non-Compliance with Electoral Orders
item.description: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court has fined Meta Platforms $1.3 million for failing to fully comply with judicial orders related to the country's elections. The court's decision followed Meta's alleged "algorithmic manipulation" during the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Train Collision in Spain Kills at Least 30
item.description: At least 30 people were killed when two high-speed trains collided in Spain. The incident involved a collision between two high-speed trains. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Moved to Military Base Amid Iran Threats
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was moved to a military base out of safety concerns following threats from Iran, according to reports. The move came after a photograph reportedly exposed his $12 million home. Iran has previously… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Soldier Arrested in UK on Suspicion of Spying for Russia
item.description: A senior U.S. Army soldier has been arrested in the United Kingdom on suspicion of attempting to steal secrets for Russia. British police and intelligence agencies were involved in the arrest. The FBI director thanked the UK authorities… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Meghan Markle's Father Jailed Again After Tampering With Ankle Monitor
item.description: Thomas Markle, 82, was returned to jail in Florida after he removed his court-ordered electronic ankle monitor, violating the terms of his pre-trial release. He had been arrested and charged with possession of child sexual abuse material… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Tarbela Dam Tunnel Flooded in Pakistan, Workers Evacuated
item.description: A breach in a protective embankment at Pakistan's Tarbela Dam fifth extension project flooded a hydropower tunnel and powerhouse area, forcing the evacuation of workers and halting construction. One worker was reported swept away. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Imran Khan returns to jail after medical treatment
item.description: Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan has returned to jail following medical treatment. The specific details of the treatment and the duration of his return to custody were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka Minister Faces FIR Plea Over RSS Social Media Post
item.description: A man in Karnataka has sought an FIR against Home Minister Priyank Kharge concerning a social media post about the RSS. A police complaint has been filed against the minister for his post on the RSS. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Student Posed as Delhi Police Officer to Block X Accounts
item.description: A Class 12 student allegedly posed as a Delhi Police officer and sent fake orders to X (formerly Twitter) to block accounts. The student has been apprehended. The Delhi Police have filed an FIR regarding the forged notices that sought to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: President's Bodyguard Shot in Diwali Night Dispute in Baghpat
item.description: A bodyguard of the President was shot in the head during a dispute that occurred on Diwali night in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh. The incident reportedly stemmed from an argument over bursting firecrackers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Dies After Blackmail Over Fake Rare Coins, AI Video
item.description: A woman died by suicide after allegedly being blackmailed using an AI-generated video and a scam involving fake rare coins. Six individuals have been arrested in connection with the case. The incident occurred in Rajasthan, and the arrests… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Election Commission Awaits Report on 'Waris Punjab De' Separatist Links
item.description: The Election Commission of India (EC) is awaiting a report concerning claims that the organization 'Waris Punjab De' has separatist links. One report suggested that registering the group could pose a risk to national sovereignty. The EC is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Train Attendant Arrested for Gold Chain Theft
item.description: A bedroll attendant working on the Cherlapally Express has been arrested for allegedly stealing a 40-gram gold chain. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Patwari and assistant arrested for taking bribe in Sonipat
item.description: In Sonipat, Haryana, a Patwari and an assistant were arrested by the ACB (Anti-Corruption Bureau) while accepting a bribe of ₹7,000. The bribe was allegedly for registering a mutation and providing a copy. The ACB team set a trap to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Elderly Woman Dies in Indore Fire
item.description: A 95-year-old woman died after a fire broke out in her bed on the third floor of a building in Indore. The woman's family claimed that the fire was caused by firecrackers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Stone pelting incident in Dewas injures six, 12 detained
item.description: A stone-pelting incident occurred in Dewas following a dispute related to a motorcycle. During the ensuing chaos, six people were injured. Twelve individuals have been taken into police custody. Another report states that four police… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Five Youths Jailed for Bike Stunts and Public Nuisance
item.description: Five youths were sent to jail for performing stunts and creating a disturbance on their bikes on a public road. The youths were engaged in objectionable acts, including vulgar stunts, reportedly to gain likes and views on social media… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kolkata Techie Murder Linked to Facebook Interactions
item.description: A techie in Kolkata was murdered, with initial investigations suggesting Facebook interactions as a potential motive. The specific details of these interactions and their direct link to the murder are under scrutiny. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India Blocked Betting Sites Using Forged Court Orders, Report Says
item.description: India ordered the blocking of 129 online betting websites based on two forged high court orders, according to a Reuters report cited by The Pioneer and Times Now. The specific details of the forged orders and the process by which they were… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Four-Year-Old Girl Raped in Goa; Bihar Man Arrested
item.description: A four-year-old girl was allegedly raped in Canacona, Goa, and a native of Bihar has been arrested in connection with the incident. This is the second reported case of a minor being raped in Goa within a week, according to police. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi University Student Suspended Over Alleged 'Luring' Scheme for Concert
item.description: Ramanujan College, affiliated with Delhi University, suspended student Anas Khan on November 6 for allegedly offering female students money, gifts, and travel benefits to accompany "NRI clients" to a Diljit Dosanjh concert in Ahmedabad… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Court Allows Lawsuits Against NSA Doval, Ex-RAW Chief Goel
item.description: A U.S. court has permitted lawsuits to proceed against India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and former Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) chief Samant Goel. The lawsuits were filed following a petition by Khalistani terrorist… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Russian Paraglider Rescued After Getting Stuck in Himachal Power Lines
item.description: A Russian paraglider was rescued in Bir Billing, Himachal Pradesh, after becoming entangled in power lines at an altitude of approximately 150 meters. The rescue operation, which lasted for about 2.5 to 3 hours, involved multiple agencies… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Sabarimala Gold Theft: SIT Seeks Prosecution Sanction, Court Urges Action
item.description: A Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the Sabarimala gold theft cases has requested sanction to prosecute accused officials. The Kerala High Court has called for expeditious action in the matter. The SIT's request and the court's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Court Summons Ex-DGP Sreelekha in Rahul Gandhi Defamation Case
item.description: A court in Kerala has summoned former Director General of Police (DGP) R. Sreelekha to appear in connection with a defamation case involving Rahul Gandhi. The summons was issued by the court for her appearance in the case. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India Rejects US Lawsuit Against NSA Doval and Ex-RAW Chief Goel
item.description: India has dismissed a civil lawsuit filed by pro-Khalistan separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in a US court against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and former Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW) chief Samant Goel. India described the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
